## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish, and what currently gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected interaction or SDK API, preferably with a small example.

## Alternatives and scope

What have you tried? Does this affect document compatibility, exports, history, package size or accessibility?

## Completion criteria

What observable result would make this feature complete?
